head.label: Prompt Gallery
head.title: Made in SPS
head.sub: Every image here was built by choosing from the studio's libraries — camera, lighting, skin, wardrobe, pose, location — and SPS assembled the prompt from those choices. What you see is exactly what it produced. Open one and take it.

items.title: Red Riding Hood
items.yaml:
task: dark_fantasy_portrait_red_riding
directive: "RED RIDING HOOD AND THE WOLF — RAIN-SOAKED FOREST, CINEMATIC HALF-LENGTH PORTRAIT"

instruction: >
  Half-length portrait of a young woman in a red riding cape holding a grey wolf close to her
  chest, both facing camera, caught in falling rain against a dark pine forest. Calm, steady,
  unafraid — the wolf is hers, not a threat.

subject:
  - Adult woman, mid twenties, Mediterranean features, dark hair in two tight dutch braids
  - Real skin with visible pores, rain beading on the forehead and cheekbone, no retouching
  - Small stud earrings, bare face, no glamour makeup

wardrobe:
  - Deep red velvet hooded cape with white lace trim, tied at the throat with a red ribbon
  - White off-shoulder peasant blouse with lace cuffs, black corset bodice over it

animal:
  - Adult grey wolf, thick winter coat, amber eyes to camera, ears up and relaxed
  - Fur wet at the guard hairs, individual hair detail, no CGI smoothness

camera_gear:
  - Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with an 85mm prime at f/2.0, eye level, subject filling the frame

lighting:
  - Single large softbox front left, cool moonlight rim from behind right through the rain
  - Deep open shadows, rain lit so each drop reads against the dark trees

grade: "Desaturated cool green-grey forest, red cape held as the only saturated colour, filmic contrast"

negative_prompt: "plastic skin, airbrushed, beauty filter, cartoon wolf, CGI fur, dry hair in rain, changed identity, extra fingers, warped hands, oversaturated, low resolution"
